svg.title: free-cup-holder.exe: cup holder installed
svg.desc: Close-up of a beige pixel-art PC on a teal desktop. A DOS prompt runs free-cup-holder.exe, the eject button clicks, the CD tray slides out with a shiny disc, the disc spins off into the recycle bin and a steaming coffee mug lands on the tray. The TURBO display climbs from 66 to 99. Cup holder installed successfully. Do not press EJECT.
